incident_count.name: Incident Count
incident_count.description: Total volume of incidents satisfying query criteria

critical_count.name: Critical Incidents
critical_count.sql_expression: SUM(CASE WHEN severity = 'Critical' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

sla_breaches.name: SLA Breaches
sla_breaches.description: Count of incidents that breached target resolution SLA
sla_breaches.sql_expression: SUM(CASE WHEN sla_breached = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

sla_breach_rate.name: SLA Breach Rate
sla_breach_rate.sql_expression: ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN sla_breached = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1)

average_resolution_time.name: Average Resolution Time (MTTR)
average_resolution_time.description: Mean time to resolution in minutes for resolved or closed incidents

average_impact_score.name: Average Impact Score
average_impact_score.description: Mean calculated business & operational impact score (1-100)
